method: Independent offline replay from archived FMTQIK market-wide original responses, STOCK_DAY raw instrument responses and TWSE notice HTML; SHA256 and receipt equality checked, dates and closes parsed independently, Decimal arithmetic compared with simulator result.
assumptions: Close-to-close normalized one-unit notional, 4:1 split, gross dividend entitlement on scheduled payment dates, no reinvestment, proportional fees/tax, no minimum fees, slippage or personal tax.
limits: Original bytes from the same CI archive, not a new independent live source retrieval or cryptographic exchange signature.
No exhaustive independent action ledger coverage or arbitrary interval certification implied.
No actual brokerage fills or bank receipts; retrospective evidence is not PIT feature provenance.
